description: Texts with DECtalk's punctuation mode pass, in which the text stage hands every character on to letter-to-sound without reading clauses or running its rules: plain sentences and their marks, marks the text rules would have taken away or rewritten (brackets, quotes, dashes, an ellipsis, repeated marks), abbreviations and numbers the text rules would have written out, symbols, a command inside the mode, and the mode turned off again. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.
